CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ptah_embedding_generation` (

    `fencing_token` Int64 NOT NULL,

    `catch_up_watermark` Utf8,
    `cursor` Utf8,
    `rows_scanned` Int64 NOT NULL,

    `retry_count` Int32 NOT NULL,
    `verification_ref` Utf8,

    `to_phase` Utf8,

    `previous_generation` Utf8,
    `cut_over_at` Timestamp NOT NULL,
    `cut_over_by` Utf8,
    `plan_digest` Utf8,
    PRIMARY KEY (`target_schema`, `target_table`)
);

targets.name: a quantized representation
targets.message: not supported on YDB: target objects: representation "uint8" is not one a YDB generation stores. YDB keeps a vector as the bytes of its float element type, so set target.representation to "float"; YDB's uint8, int8 and bit types hold quantized vectors, which an embedding provider does not return

targets.name: a chunked table of its own
a table of its own that is the source
targets.message: target objects: layout "own_table" names the source table app/articles as its target, and under this layout Ptah creates that table and drops it when the generation is retired. Name a table of the generation's own, or use the default layout to put the columns on the source

targets.name: a table of its own in another directory
a pgvector method
targets.message: not supported on YDB: index method "hnsw" is not one YDB builds; a YDB vector index is vector_kmeans_tree

targets.name: an hnsw parameter
targets.message: not supported on YDB: storage parameter "m" belongs to pgvector's hnsw index; a vector_kmeans_tree index is shaped by its levels and clusters

targets.name: an ivfflat parameter
targets.message: not supported on YDB: storage parameter "lists" belongs to pgvector's ivfflat index; a vector_kmeans_tree index is shaped by its levels and clusters

targets.name: an unknown option
targets.message: not supported on YDB: storage parameter "overlap" has no YDB counterpart: a vector_kmeans_tree index takes its settings as the distance or similarity, vector_type, vector_dimension, levels and clusters attributes

targets.name: no levels
targets.message: a vector_kmeans_tree index needs index_options levels and clusters: YDB 25.3 and later refuse an index without either, and 25.1 reports back no default for them

targets.name: no options
targets.message: a vector_kmeans_tree index needs index_options levels and clusters: YDB 25.3 and later refuse an index without either, and 25.1 reports back no default for them

targets.name: levels that are not a number
targets.message: index option levels is "two", not a whole number

targets.name: one cluster
targets.message: a vector index's clusters are between 2 and 2048 (`Invalid clusters: 1 should be between 2 and 2048`)

targets.name: too many clusters
targets.message: a vector index's clusters are between 2 and 2048 (`Invalid clusters: 2049 should be between 2 and 2048`)

targets.name: too many levels
targets.message: a vector index's levels are between 1 and 16 (`Invalid levels: 17 should be between 1 and 16`)

targets.name: too large a tree
targets.message: a vector index's clusters to the power of its levels is at most 1073741824 (`Invalid clusters^levels: 2048^3 should be less than 1073741824`)

targets.name: too wide an indexed vector
targets.message: a vector index's vector_dimension is between 1 and 16384 (`Invalid vector_dimension: 16385 should be between 1 and 16384`)
